# 13 Design Studio

> A digital product design agency for AI-native and AI-built products. We turn AI features and AI-generated MVPs into products people trust and understand at first glance. Based in Kraków, Poland; working with founders everywhere.

13 Design Studio designs digital products — flows, screens, interaction patterns, design systems, and developer-ready specs — specifically for teams building with AI. Two kinds of clients: startups building AI-native products from day one, and established businesses adding AI to an existing product. All design work is done by humans; nothing about the flows, screens, or decisions is generated.

Positioning: designed by humans, for humans and agents — interfaces people understand at first glance, structured so AI agents can navigate them without guessing.

## What we do

- AI UX & product design — end-to-end design for AI-native and AI-built products
- AI-integration UX — designing the UX around AI features added to existing products
- UX rescue sprint — a focused engagement to fix what's broken now
- Product finishing — turning an AI-generated MVP into something intentional
- Design systems & maintenance — components, tokens, and specs kept current
- Fractional product partner — an ongoing part-time design and product lead (the Product Partner tier)

## Pricing (month-to-month design subscriptions)

- Lite — $800/month — up to 5 days of design capacity. Self-serve.
- Standard — $2,500/month — up to 12 days of design capacity. Self-serve.
- Product Partner — $4,500/month — up to 20 days of design capacity; scoped on a call first.

Fixed monthly price, no annual contract, no lock-in, cancel anytime. A "day" means a day of reserved studio capacity, not tracked hours. Unused days do not roll over.
